designs.why: Single-ink, clean solid fills and consistent line weight; vehicles read clearly at 3 m, big title block has strong hierarchy, the curve running off the top edge and the minivan outlier carry the joke. Print-safe weights, no tints or halftones. Weak spots: the minivan dot is tucked against the roof/rear corner and reads like a stray blob rather than a data point, the axis labels are small for a tee, and the bicycle spokes and motorcycle engine detail are fine and may fill in on mesh.
designs.fix: Move the minivan dot clear of the van body (a visible gap, matching the other dots' offset) so it reads as its own data point; secondarily thicken the finest spoke/engine lines to at least 0.5 mm.
